title: Northrop Grumman's corporate security as an enforcement arm

tellings.quote: I I they seem to have been given um for some time now the the authority to to implement uh program security through their corporate security forces

plain: Matthew Brown, who calls himself a Pentagon whistleblower, says the defense contractor Northrop Grumman has for some time been given the authority to enforce the security of secret programmes through its own corporate security force. He tells Michels this from what he says he saw himself. If true, it would mean a private company, not the government, polices who learns about these programmes.
